pages.name: Russian Game: 3.d3
pages.notes: Plan 2 had an ambiguous Nd2-f1-g3 with the f1-bishop at home; now Be2, O-O, Re1 and Nbd2-f1-g3. British spelling in the overview and plan 3.

pages.name: Russian Game: 5.Qe2, Queenswap
pages.notes: Plan 1 targeted an e5-pawn that isn't there; plan 2 had Re1 before castling and '0-0'; plan 3 had '...0-0' and both ...c6 and ...Nc6. Rewrote plans 1-3 around the open e-file, Nc3-b5 and long castling. British spelling in the overview and plan 4.

pages.name: Russian Game: Classical, 5...d5
pages.notes: Plan 3 named 'squares like e5 and d4', read as moves; rewrote it around the fight for the e4-knight. British spelling in the overview and plan 2.

pages.name: Russian Game: Classical, 6.Bd3 Be7
pages.notes: Plan 1 had Re1 supporting an e4-pawn White no longer has (e4 holds Black's knight); fixed. British spelling in the overview and plans 2 and 3.

pages.name: Russian Game: Classical, Chigorin, 8...Bf5
pages.notes: Plan 1 had a d2-b3 knight route; now 9.c4 Nb4 10.Bf1 O-O 11.a3 Nc6 12.Nc3. Plan 2's ...c5 replaced with ...O-O, ...Bf6, ...Re8 and ...Nb4. Plan 3 claimed the f5-bishop pins and could take on f3; rewritten (a first rewrite with Bxe4 'exchanging' the bishop was rejected).

pages.name: Russian-Three Knights Game
pages.notes: The overview and plan 1 called 3...Bb4 a pin (the d2-pawn stands in the way) and missed 4.Nxe5; rewrote them. Notation in plan 2 (...Bxc3) and plan 3 (O-O); British spelling.

pages.name: Petrov's Defense: Modern Attack, Bardeleben Variation
pages.notes: Plan 2 had Black's ...bxc6 after White's unplayed Nxc6 and ...d5 'dismantling' the centre; rewrote it (a first rewrite insisting on the b-pawn recapture was rejected as unconfirmed). British spelling in the overview and plans 1, 3 and 4.

pages.name: Petrov's Defense: Modern Attack, Trifunovic Variation
pages.notes: Plans 1 and 2 supported or blockaded an e5-pawn before White has recaptured; now 8.dxe5 and ...Nc6 against the new pawn. British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Russian Game: Modern Attack, 3...exd4, Main Line, 7.Nc3
pages.notes: The overview credited White with an e5-pawn that has been exchanged; plan 1 pinned an f6-knight that is on d6; plan 2 had '...0-0'. Rewrote all three.

pages.name: Russian Game: Modern Attack, 3...Nxe4 4.Bd3 d5 5.Nxe5 Nd7 6.Nxd7
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...O-O with the f8-bishop at home; now ...Bd6 and ...O-O, or ...Qh4 and long castling. British spelling in the overview and plan 3.
